description: This file contains functions for reading a file into memory and printing input/output data, primarily used in unit tests. It includes file handling, memory management, and printing functionalities related to testing utilities for file content processing.

methods.name: int read_file_into_memory(const char * filename,test_ut_memory_t * pInstance)
methods.description: Reads the contents of a specified file into a memory buffer within a test utility structure, handling file opening, size determination, memory allocation, and reading with error-checking.

methods.name: void print_input_output(char * kvpData,const char * filename)
methods.description: Prints the content read from a file and the supplied key-value pair data, utilizes the read_file_into_memory function and outputs formatted debug information.
